cohort: The study included 346 pregnant women who contracted SARS-CoV-2 during the first trimester following IVF-frozen embryo transfer and 705 uninfected pregnant women from the pre-pandemic period as controls.
finding: Contracting COVID-19 during the first trimester did not adversely impact future obstetric and perinatal outcomes following in vitro fertilization-frozen embryo transfer.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences observed in the mode of delivery between the infected and control groups.
